name: schema-and-cleanup
description: Fix data that has gone wrong and change shape without breaking what reads it: duplicates, nulls, inconsistent document shapes, a field that means two things, a column that has to change. Use when a report cannot be built because the data is not in the right shape, when duplicates, nulls or inconsistent shapes are producing wrong numbers, when a field is needed or has to change, before a migration, or when onboarding data from a new source that does not match the standard shape.
